title: Zucchini Involtini
subtitle: with ricotta and pecorino in tomato sauce
description: Grilled zucchini slices rolled around a lemony ricotta and pecorino filling and baked in a quick tomato sauce until bubbling.

steps.text: Brush the zucchini slices (cut lengthways about 3 mm thick) with olive oil. Heat a grill pan and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side until browned with grill marks. Cool well.

Mix the ricotta, pecorino, breadcrumbs, chives, 2 finely chopped garlic cloves, chilli, lemon zest and salt and pepper in a bowl. Place a spoonful at the end of each zucchini slice and roll up into a plump roll.

Mix the crushed tomatoes, water, 1 tablespoon olive oil, 1 finely chopped garlic clove, sugar, oregano, salt and pepper and pour into a 26 cm baking dish, about 2 cm deep. Place the rolls in the sauce.

Bake for about 20 minutes until the sauce bubbles and the filling at the sides of the rolls begins to turn golden. If not serving immediately, cover and refrigerate for up to 2 days and reheat for 10 minutes in a 170°C oven.
